notes: Level 8 Dark warrior roaming the corridors of the Dark Warriors' Fortress (low-level Wilderness, north-west of Edgeville); 17 hitpoints.

taskNotes: Dark warriors are assigned only by Krystilia and must be killed in the Wilderness to count; there is no combat, Slayer or quest requirement.
slayerTargetId 256 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
The slayer-countable Dark warriors are the level 8 warriors of the Dark Warriors' Fortress (low-level Wilderness north-west of Edgeville).
They have huge melee defensive bonuses (stab +96) but zero magic and ranged defence, so magic or ranged is by far the fastest style.
No task extension unlock exists for Dark warriors.
recommendedMethod: Attack the level 8 Dark warriors in the Dark Warriors' Fortress with magic or ranged; their melee defence is very high (stab +96) but magic and ranged defence are zero. The fortress is low-level Wilderness, but bring risk-appropriate gear.
